verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own docs say it runs inference through `Apple MLX` alongside llama.cpp, and exposes GPU offload control (`--gpu=max`). A community user calls it one of the most efficient ways to run LLMs on Apple Silicon now that it supports MLX. However, the docs never explicitly describe Metal acceleration or native ARM builds, and one hands-on report found it much slower than Ollama on an M1 Mac. That report weakens confidence but does not show acceleration is absent. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of Metal/ARM-native acceleration, performance benchmarks on Apple Silicon, consistent independent corroboration of speed.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get accelerated inference on Apple Silicon via native ARM and Metal optimizations

citations.quote: Now that LM Studio supports MLX models, it's one of the most efficient too.
